mentions.name: Luminum
mentions.description: A Raspberry Pi OS modification for kids that turns a Raspberry Pi into a dedicated home learning computer with no usage limits, focused on learning rather than games. Currently in use by the author's child.
mentions.problem: Home devices for kids tend to be dominated by games; there is no no-limit device at home dedicated to learning.
mentions.audience: Kids learning at home (currently the author's own child).
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Raspberry PI OS mod for kids - https://luminum.tech/ I have one user (my kid). The core of the idea is to have one no-limit device at home that is dedicated to learning and not games.

evidence.value: I am working on Raspberry PI OS mod for kids - https://luminum.tech/ I have one user (my kid). The core of the idea is to have one no-limit device at home that is dedicated to learning and not games.
